rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for questioning someone closely, persistently, or aggressively.

example.english: They kept trying to interrogate me until I was speechless.
example.traditional: 佢不停盤問我，問到我口啞啞。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bat1 ting4 pun4 man6 ngo5 man6 dou3 ngo5 hau2 aa2 aa2

rows.note: Use this especially for police questioning or an official interview, without necessarily stressing aggressive pressure.

example.english: The police asked me to go to the station so they could interrogate me about the whole matter.
example.traditional: 警察叫我返差館問話，話要了解成件事。
example.jyutping: ging2 caat3 giu3 ngo5 faan1 caai1 gun2 man6 waa6 waa6 jiu3 liu5 gaai2 sing4 gin6 si6
